facts.label: Sexta da pizza
facts.sub: Em muitos escritórios, a sexta-feira tem pizza para todos. Alguém pede várias caixas e os colegas comem juntos na sala de descanso. É um jeito simples de fazer amigos.

pages.title: A bite of the olive one · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Friday, twelve thirty, in a busy office in Seattle. On the break room table, there are five big pizza boxes. Rita is new, so she is a little shy at the door. Her coworker Dan waves at her and smiles. Crumbs are already on the table, and everyone is hungry. Dan walks over to invite her.
“Hi, Rita! Do you want to eat pizza with us today?” says Dan. “Sure! Which toppings do you have?” says Rita. “Mushroom, olive and extra sausage.” says Dan.
